q: Which language is better for writing structured code?
o: More than one of the above
x: Pascal में block structure (begin...end), if / while / repeat जैसे control structures हैं, इसलिए structured code के लिए यह सबसे अच्छी मानी गई. BPSC key: (A).

q: Select the true statement for compiler.
o: The input of the compiler is source program.
It translates the source code into object code as a whole.
The output of the compiler is object code.
More than one of the above
x: Compiler: input = source program, पूरा program एक साथ translate, output = object code. तीनों statement सही, इसलिए (D) More than one of the above.

q: Which shortcut key is used to compile and run the program in C++?
o: More than one of the above
x: Turbo C++ IDE (Integrated Development Environment) में Ctrl+F9 दबाने से program compile भी होता है और run भी. Alt+F9 = सिर्फ compile, Alt+F5 = output screen.

q: Which of the following is userdefined header file extension used in C++?
o: More than one of the above
x: C++ में अपनी header file .h extension से बनाते हैं और #include "myfile.h" (double quotes) से जोड़ते हैं. System header जैसे <iostream> angle brackets में.

q: A computer program that converts an assembly language program into equivalent machine language program is called
o: More than one of the above
x: Assembly language (MOV, ADD जैसे mnemonics) -> machine code (0/1) = assembler. BPSC key (provisional): (B).

q: A computer program that converts a high-level language program into an equivalent machine language program is called
o: More than one of the above
x: High-level language (C++) का पूरा program -> उसके बराबर machine language program = compiler. BPSC key (provisional): (B).

q: A computer program that translates high-level language program into machine language program statement-by-statement is called
o: More than one of the above
x: 'Statement-by-statement' keyword = interpreter (जैसे Python). Object file नहीं बनती, हर run में interpreter चाहिए. BPSC key (provisional): (C).

q: Which of the following is not a system tool?
o: More than one of the above
x: Scandisk और Format system utilities हैं जो disk पर काम करते हैं. Folder कोई काम नहीं करता, बस files रखता है. BPSC key (provisional): (C).

q: Which of the following system softwares resides always in main memory?
o: More than one of the above
x: बाकी हर program को main memory में लाने का काम loader का है, इसलिए वह पहले से memory में होना चाहिए. Linker और assembler ज़रूरत पर load होते हैं. BPSC key (provisional): (A). (Bootstrap loader ROM में होता है, वो अलग बात है.)

q: Group of instructions that directs a computer is called
o: More than one of the above
x: Program = किसी काम के लिए instructions का क्रम से लिखा group. Memory/storage उसे सिर्फ रखते हैं. BPSC key (provisional): (C).

q: The process of assigning load addresses to the various parts of the program and adjusting the code and data in the program to reflect the assigned addresses is called _______.
x: Program को memory में किसी भी जगह रखो, तो उसके अंदर के addresses उसी हिसाब से बदलने पड़ते हैं. यही Relocation है (linker / relocating loader का काम).

q: In a two-pass assembler, symbol table is
o: Generated and used only in second pass
x: Two-pass assembler: Pass 1 = symbol table बनाना (index बनाना), Pass 2 = उसी table से machine code बनाना (page number भरना).

q: Which of the following statement(s) regarding a linker software is/are true ? I. A function of a linker is to combine several object modules into a single load module. II A function of a linker is to replace absolute references in an object module by symbolic references to locations in other modules.
x: I: linker कई object modules को एक load module में जोड़ता है, सही. II: linker symbolic references को addresses से replace करता है, absolute को symbolic से नहीं, इसलिए II गलत. जवाब Only I.

q: Machine Level Language is a/an
x: Machine language सिर्फ 0 और 1 में होती है जिसे CPU (Central Processing Unit) सीधे समझता है. यह low-level language है.

q: Which of the following is NOT an example of system software?
x: OS (Operating System), device drivers और utilities = system software. Spreadsheet हिसाब-किताब जैसा user का काम करता है, इसलिए application software.

q: Software that is permanently stored in ROM/flash and initialises the hardware when a computer is switched on is called:
x: Power on पर hardware को शुरू (initialise) करने वाला BIOS/UEFI (Unified Extensible Firmware Interface) ROM/flash में रहता है, यही firmware है.

q: Software that can be used free for a trial period, after which the user is expected to pay to continue using it, is:
x: Shareware कुछ दिन मुफ़्त चलता है, फिर license खरीदना पड़ता है (जैसे WinRAR trial).

q: Under the GNU GPL (General Public License), which condition applies when a modified version of the software is distributed?
o: Its source code must be kept secret
It must also be released under the GPL with source code available
It can never be sold for a fee
It may be used only for non-commercial purposes
x: GPL copyleft licence है: बदला version बाँटो तो वो भी GPL में और source code के साथ. Fee लेना allowed है, इसलिए (C) गलत.

q: Assembly language belongs to which generation of programming languages?
x: 1GL machine, 2GL assembly, 3GL C++/Java/Python, 4GL SQL, 5GL Prolog.

q: SQL (Structured Query Language) is generally classified as a:
x: SQL में हम सिर्फ बताते हैं क्या चाहिए (SELECT ... WHERE), कैसे निकालना है वो DBMS (Database Management System) तय करता है. इसलिए 4GL.

q: Prolog, a logic programming language used in AI (Artificial Intelligence), is usually placed in the:
x: 5GL में rules/constraints देते हैं और system खुद हल ढूँढता है. Prolog AI और expert systems में use होती है.

q: Which phase of a compiler reads the source program character by character and groups the characters into tokens?
x: Compiler का पहला phase lexical analysis है: source को character by character पढ़कर keyword, identifier, operator जैसे tokens बनाता है, comments/space हटाता है.

q: Type checking (for example, detecting that an integer is added to a string) is mainly performed in which compiler phase?
x: Integer + string जोड़ना grammar में ठीक लग सकता है, पर मतलब गलत है. मतलब (type) check = semantic analysis.

q: A compiler that runs on one machine (platform A) but produces executable code for a different machine (platform B) is called a:
x: जैसे PC (Personal Computer, x86) पर बैठकर ARM (Advanced RISC Machines) / Arduino के लिए code बनाना. Embedded systems में बहुत common.

q: In Java, the javac compiler translates a .java source file into:
o: Native machine code of the CPU
Bytecode in a .class file, executed by the JVM
x: Java: source (.java) -> javac -> bytecode (.class) -> JVM. Bytecode platform-independent है: 'write once, run anywhere'.

q: A JIT (Just-In-Time) compiler:
o: Translates bytecode/intermediate code into native machine code at run time
Compiles the whole source program before the software is distributed
Executes source code line by line without any translation
Converts machine code back into high-level source code
x: JIT बार-बार चलने वाले (hot) bytecode को native code में बदलकर cache करता है, इसलिए interpreter से तेज़. Example: Java HotSpot, .NET CLR (Common Language Runtime).

q: Writing a compiler for a language in that same language and then compiling it with a simpler, already available version of the compiler is called:
x: पहले छोटा subset compiler (assembly या दूसरी language में), फिर उससे पूरी language में लिखा बड़ा compiler compile. जैसे C compiler C में लिखा होना.

q: Which statement about an absolute loader is correct?
o: It performs both relocation and linking
It loads the object program at the address specified by the assembler/programmer, without relocation
It loads routines only when they are called at run time
x: Absolute loader सबसे simple है: object code वहीं रखता है जहाँ लिखा है. Relocation/linking नहीं, इसलिए program दूसरी जगह नहीं चल सकता.

q: Compared with a subroutine (function) call, using a macro generally:
o: Increases program size but avoids the call/return overhead
Reduces program size and adds call/return overhead
Is executed with CALL and RET instructions
Is expanded by the loader at run time
x: Macro = हर call की जगह पूरी body चिपक जाती है (code बड़ा, speed ज़्यादा). Subroutine = एक copy, हर बार call/return (code छोटा, थोड़ा धीमा).

q: In C++, lines such as #include <iostream> and #define PI 3.14 are processed by the:
x: Compiler से पहले preprocessor चलता है: #include header की text चिपकाता है और #define PI 3.14 में PI को 3.14 से बदल देता है (macro substitution).

q: Secondary memory is the longterm store for programs and data while main memory holds program and data currently in use. What kind of an organization is this?
o: More than one of the above
x: Secondary memory (hard disk) लंबे समय के लिए रखती है, main memory (RAM) अभी चल रहे program को. यह असली hardware (physical) की व्यवस्था है, इसलिए Physical. BPSC key: (A).

q: What does the control unit generate to control other units?
o: More than one of the above
x: CU खुद हिसाब नहीं करता. वह ALU, memory, I/O को control signals भेजकर बताता है कि कब क्या करना है. सवाल में 'control' शब्द ही जवाब का इशारा है.

q: The most common addressing technique employed by a CPU is
o: More than one of the above
x: CPU (Central Processing Unit) direct, indirect और immediate तीनों तरीके आम तौर पर use करता है. एक से ज़्यादा सही, इसलिए (D) More than one of the above.

q: In various devices, _____ are used to overcome the difference in data transfer speed.
o: More than one of the above
x: तेज़ CPU और धीमे device (जैसे printer) के बीच buffer register बीच में data रखता है. इससे दोनों अपनी speed से काम कर लेते हैं.

q: What do we use to extend the connectivity of the processor bus?
o: More than one of the above
x: Processor bus पर ज़्यादा devices नहीं लगा सकते. इसलिए एक bridge से PCI bus जोड़ते हैं, जिस पर बाकी devices लगते हैं. यानी connectivity extend = PCI bus.

q: In memory mapped I/O
o: the I/O devices and the memory share the same address space
the I/O devices have a separate address space
the memory and I/O devices have an associated address space
More than one of the above
x: Memory-mapped I/O में कुछ addresses I/O devices को दे दिए जाते हैं, इसलिए वही LOAD/STORE (LDA/STA) instructions I/O पर भी चलते हैं. अलग space + IN/OUT = I/O-mapped I/O.

q: What is the addressing called that is used in an instruction of the form ADD X Y?
o: More than one of the above
x: ADD X Y में operands के memory address X और Y सीधे लिखे हैं. यही absolute (direct) addressing है: EA (Effective Address) = instruction में दिया address.

q: Who is the father of computer?
o: More than one of the above
x: Charles Babbage ने Difference Engine और Analytical Engine (1834) की योजना बनाई, जिसमें आज के computer जैसे हिस्से थे. इसलिए Father of Computer.

q: In IA-32 architecture along with the general flags, which of the following conditional flags is provided?
o: More than one of the above
x: IA-32 (Intel Architecture, 32-bit) के EFLAGS register में status flags के साथ TF, IF, IOPL भी हैं. Note: logic से ये control/system flags हैं, condition flags नहीं; फिर भी तीनों मौजूद हैं, इसलिए key (D) ठीक है.

q: The method of accessing the I/O devices by repeatedly checking the status flags is
o: More than one of the above
x: Programmed (program-controlled) I/O में CPU बार-बार device का status देखता है कि ready है या नहीं. इसमें CPU का समय बर्बाद होता है.

q: Which of the following natural elements is the primary element in computer chips?
o: More than one of the above
x: Silicon semiconductor है (कभी current चलाए, कभी रोके). Transistors और IC (Integrated Circuit) मुख्य रूप से silicon से बनते हैं.

q: The brain of computer is
o: More than one of the above
x: CPU (Central Processing Unit) में ALU हिसाब करता है और CU सबको आदेश देता है. इसलिए CPU को brain of computer कहते हैं.

q: Intel 8085 microprocessor is of _____ generation.
o: More than one of the above
x: NCERT Table 1.2: second generation (1974-78) = 8-bit, Intel 8085 और Motorola 6800. Exam में NCERT वाली table ही मानो.

q: The maximum memory size of third generation microprocessor is
o: More than one of the above
x: NCERT table का Max memory column: 1 KB, 1 MB, 16 MB, 4 GB, 64 GB. Third = 16 MB (24 address lines -> 2^24). Note: असली 8086 = 1 MB, 16 MB 80286 का है; BPSC ने table वाला 16 MB माना.

q: CPU on a single chip is called
o: More than one of the above
x: Microprocessor में ALU + CU + registers एक IC पर होते हैं. 'CPU on a chip' = processor, 'computer on a chip' = controller.

q: Computer on a single chip is called
o: More than one of the above
x: Microcontroller (जैसे 8051) में CPU, RAM, ROM और I/O ports एक ही chip पर होते हैं - washing machine, remote में लगता है.

q: Which one of the following is used for playing video games?
o: More than one of the above
x: Joystick एक lever है जो हर दिशा में घूमता है, इसलिए video games में use होता है.

q: _____ is used to store softwares that does not update.
o: More than one of the above
x: जो software कभी update नहीं होता (BIOS, firmware) उसे ROM (Read Only Memory) में रखते हैं, क्योंकि power जाने पर भी रहता है.

q: Which of the following contains a laser?
o: More than one of the above
x: CD/DVD drive में laser beam disc की सतह पढ़ता/लिखता है. HDD (Hard Disk Drive) magnetic है, RAM electronic.

q: The three main components of a digital computer system are
o: More than one of the above
x: Computer = CPU (processing) + memory (storage) + I/O (input/output). ALU, CPU का हिस्सा है, इसलिए B गलत.

q: FFFF will be the last memory location in a memory of size
o: More than one of the above
x: FFFF में 4 hex अंक = 16 bits. 16 bits से 2^16 = 65536 = 64K addresses बनते हैं (0 से 65535).

q: The cost of storing a bit is minimum in
o: More than one of the above
x: Memory hierarchy में नीचे जाने पर cost per bit घटती है. Registers सबसे ऊपर (महँगे), magnetic tape सबसे नीचे (सस्ता, धीमा).

q: The register that contains the address of the next instruction to be executed is called
o: More than one of the above
x: PC हर fetch के बाद बढ़ता है और हमेशा next instruction का address बताता है.

q: The register that contains the instruction that is being executed is called
o: More than one of the above
x: Fetch के बाद instruction IR (Instruction Register) में आता है, वहीं से CU उसे decode करके चलाता है.

q: The register which holds the address of location of memory to and from which data are to be transferred is known as
o: More than one of the above
x: MAR = address (कहाँ से पढ़ना/लिखना), MBR/MDR = data (क्या पढ़ा/लिखा). 'Address of location' शब्द MAR बताता है.

q: A storage device used to compensate the difference in flow of data is known as
o: More than one of the above
x: Buffer दो devices (जैसे CPU और printer) के बीच data थोड़ी देर रखता है, ताकि तेज़ और धीमा device अपनी रफ़्तार से चलें.

q: Memory in which any location can be reached in a fixed amount of time after specifying its address is called
o: More than one of the above
x: Random Access = किसी भी location तक बराबर समय. Tape में आगे वाली location तक पहुँचने में ज़्यादा समय लगता है.

q: Which of the following is the type of Read Only Memory (ROM)?
o: More than one of the above
x: PROM (एक बार program), EPROM (UV से मिटाओ), MROM (factory में भरी) - तीनों ROM के प्रकार हैं. इसलिए (D) More than one of the above.

q: Which of the following is NOT a type of interrupt?
o: More than one of the above
x: Interrupt के types = hardware (external), software (instruction से) और internal (trap/exception). 'Memory interrupt' इनमें नहीं.

q: Cached and interleaved memories are ways of speeding up memory access between CPU’s and slower RAM. Which memory models are best suited (i.e. improves the performance most) for which programs ? (i) Cached memory is best suited for small loops. (ii) Interleaved memory is best suited for small loops (iii) Interleaved memory is best suited for large sequential code. (iv) Cached memory is best suited for large sequential code.
x: Cache locality पर चलता है: छोटा loop वही instructions बार-बार चलाता है, इसलिए cache में hit. Interleaved memory में लगातार addresses अलग modules में होते हैं, तो लंबा sequential code तेज़ पढ़ा जाता है.

q: Interrupts which are initiated by an instruction are
x: जो interrupt program के किसी instruction से जानबूझकर पैदा किया जाए (जैसे INT 21H), वह software interrupt है.

q: A complete microcomputer system consists of
x: Microcomputer = microprocessor (CPU) + memory + I/O (peripheral) devices. तीनों मिलकर पूरा system, इसलिए All of the above.

q: Pipelining strategy is called implement
x: Pipelining की शुरुआती form को instruction prefetch कहते हैं - 8086 का 6-byte queue पहले से अगले instructions ले आता है.

q: The essential difference between traps and interrupts is
o: traps are asynchronous and interrupts are synchronous with the program.
traps are synchronous and interrupts are asynchronous with the program.
traps are synchronous and interrupts are asynchronous with the I/O devices.
x: Trap program के instruction से होता है (divide by zero, system call), हर बार उसी जगह - synchronous. Interrupt बाहर के device से कभी भी आ सकता है - asynchronous.

q: The concept of pipelining is most effective in improving performance if the tasks being performed in different stages:
o: require about the same amount of time
require different amount of time with time difference between any two tasks being same
require different amount with time difference between any two tasks being different
x: Pipeline का clock सबसे धीमी stage से तय होता है. सभी stages बराबर हों तो कोई stage खाली नहीं बैठती, performance सबसे अच्छी.

q:
Identify the addressing modes of below instructions and match them:
(a) ADI (1) Immediate addressing
(b) STA (2) Direct addressing
(c) CMA (3) Implied addressing
(d) SUB (4) Register addressing
x: 8085 में: ADI 20H (data instruction में = immediate), STA 2050H (address दिया = direct), CMA (सिर्फ accumulator, operand छिपा = implied), SUB B (register = register mode).

q: A CPU generally handles an interrupt by executing an interrupt service routine
o: As soon as an interrupt is raised
By checking the interrupt register at the end of fetch cycle
By checking the interrupt register after finishing the executing the current instruction
By checking the interrupt register at fixed time intervals
x: CPU हर instruction के अंत में देखता है कि interrupt आया क्या. आया हो तो PC save करके ISR (Interrupt Service Routine) चलाता है.

q:
Identify the devices given below with their IC numbers:
(i) USART (a) 8251
(ii) Micro controller (b) 8051
(iii) Interrupt controller (c) 8259
(iv) DMA controller (d) 8257
(i) (ii) (iii) (iv)
x: Intel ICs: 8251 = USART (serial), 8051 = microcontroller, 8259 = PIC (Programmable Interrupt Controller), 8257 = DMA (Direct Memory Access) controller.

q: In which addressing mode, the effective address of the operand is generated by adding a constant value to the contents of register ?
x: Index addressing: EA (Effective Address) = instruction में दिया constant + index register. Array के i-वें element तक पहुँचने में काम आता है.

q: One of the main features that distinguish microprocessor from micro-computers is
o: words are usually larger in microprocessors.
microprocessor does not contain I/O devices.
x: Microprocessor सिर्फ CPU chip है. Microcomputer = microprocessor + memory + I/O. इसलिए मुख्य फर्क = I/O devices.

q: Which one of the following is not an addressing mode ?
x: Register indirect, autoincrement और immediate - तीनों किताबों के standard modes हैं. 'Relative indexed' list में नहीं (NET key).

q: Computers can have instruction formats with
o: only two address and three address instructions
only one address and two address instructions
only one address, two address and three address instructions
zero address, one address, two address and three address instructions
x: 0-address = stack (PUSH/POP), 1-address = accumulator, 2- और 3-address = registers/memory. इसलिए सभी formats हो सकते हैं.

q: Which is not a typical program control instruction ?
x: Program control instructions program का रास्ता बदलते या जाँचते हैं (BR, JMP, CALL, TST, CMP). SHL bits खिसकाता है, इसलिए data manipulation.

q: Interrupt which arises from illegal or erroneous use of an instruction or data is
x: Illegal opcode, overflow, divide by zero जैसी गलती CPU के अंदर से पैदा होती है - इसे internal interrupt (trap/exception) कहते हैं.

q: A job has four pages A, B, C, D and the main memory has two page frames only. The job needs to process its pages in following order : ABACABDBACD Assuming that a page interrupt occurs when a new page is brought in the main memory, irrespective of whether the page is swapped out or not. The number of page interrupts in FIFO and LRU page replacement algorithms are
x: 2 frames, string A B A C A B D B A C D (11 references). हर नया page लाने पर page interrupt गिनो (शुरू के 2 भी). FIFO सबसे पुराना हटाता है, LRU सबसे देर से unused.

q: The hit ratio of a Translation Look Aside Buffer (TLAB) is 80%. It takes 20 nanoseconds (ns) to search TLAB and 100 ns to access main memory. The effective memory access time is ______.
x: Hit: TLB search (20) + data access (100). Miss: TLB search (20) + page table access (100) + data access (100). दोनों का weighted average.

q: The speed up of a pipeline processing over an equivalent non-pipeline processing is defined by the ratio:
o:
S = (k + n – 1)tp / n tn
Where n → no. of tasks
tn → time of completion of each task
k → no. of segments of pipeline
tp → clock cycle time
S → speed up ratio
x: Speed-up = बिना pipeline का समय / pipeline का समय. बिना pipeline = n x tn; k-stage pipeline = (k + n - 1) x tp.

q: A given memory chip has 14 address pins and 8 data pins. It has the following number of locations.
x: Locations सिर्फ address pins से तय होती हैं: n pins -> 2^n. Data pins (8) बताते हैं कि हर location 8-bit (1 byte) की है.

q: The instruction: MOV CL, [BX] [DI] + 8 represent the _____ addressing mode.
x: MOV CL, [BX][DI]+8: EA = BX (base register) + DI (index register) + 8 (displacement). Base और index दोनों हैं, इसलिए Based Indexed (displacement के साथ).

q: Which of the following is a technique that marks the beginning of computer communications?
o: More than one of the above
x: Time sharing में कई users दूर के terminals से एक ही computer पर एक साथ काम करने लगे. इसे computer communication की शुरुआत माना जाता है.

q: Which of the following is not an operating system?
o: More than one of the above
x: Oracle database software है जो data store करता है. Linux और Windows OS (Operating System) हैं.

q: A software that runs on a computer hardware and serves as a platform for other softwares to run is called
o: More than one of the above
x: 'Platform for other softwares' वाक्य OS की परिभाषा है. System software भी कुछ हद तक सही लगता है, पर BPSC key: (B) operating system.

q: The key/keys used to delete a file without allowing it to store in recycle bin is/are
o: More than one of the above
x: Windows में Shift + Delete दबाने पर file Recycle Bin में नहीं जाती, सीधे permanent delete होती है.

q: Which of the following is a type of operating system?
o: More than one of the above
x: RTOS (Real-Time Operating System), Embedded OS और NOS (Network Operating System) तीनों OS के प्रकार हैं. एक से ज़्यादा option सही हैं, इसलिए (D).

q: Suppose it takes 100 ns to access page table and 20 ns to access associative memory. If the average access time is 28 ns, the corresponding hit rate is :
x: TLB (Translation Lookaside Buffer) / associative memory में page मिला (hit) तो 20 ns; नहीं मिला (miss) तो page table से 100 ns. इस सवाल में miss पर सिर्फ 100 ns माना गया है.

q: Assume N segments in memory and a page size of P bytes. The wastage on account of internal fragmentation is :
x: Internal fragmentation (अंदर का खाली हिस्सा) हर segment के आखिरी page में होता है. औसतन आधा page = P/2 बर्बाद. N segments हैं, तो कुल NP/2.
P1 पहले S लेता है, P2 पहले Q लेता है. अब P1 को Q चाहिए (P2 के पास) और P2 को S चाहिए (P1 के पास). दोनों हमेशा के लिए रुक गए. यही Deadlock (circular wait) है.

q: Pre-emptive scheduling is the strategy of temporarily suspending a gunning process
o: before the CPU time slice expires
to allow starving processes to run
x: Pre-emptive scheduling में OS (Operating System) चलते हुए process को ज़बरदस्ती रोक कर CPU (Central Processing Unit) किसी और को दे सकता है. (सवाल में 'gunning' असल में 'running' है.)

q: In round robin CPU scheduling as time quantum is increased the average turn around time
x: Round Robin में time quantum बढ़ाने पर average TAT का कोई fixed नियम नहीं. यह processes के burst time पर depend करता है, इसलिए 'varies irregularly'.

q: Consider the following page trace : 4,3, 2, 1, 4, 3, 5, 4, 3, 2, 1, 5 Percentage of page fault that would occur if FIFO page replacement algorithm is used with number of frames for the JOB m = 4 will be
x: FIFO (First In First Out) में सबसे पुराना page बाहर जाता है. 4 frames के साथ 12 में से 10 page faults होते हैं. सवाल 'percentage' पूछता है (10/12 = 83.3%), पर official key option (C) = 10 है, यानी faults की संख्या.

q: Suppose that a given application is run on a 64-processor machine and that 70 percent of the application can be parallelized. Then the expected performance improvement using Amdahl’s law is
x: Amdahl's law: program का serial (जो parallel न हो सके) हिस्सा speed की सीमा तय करता है. 30% serial है, इसलिए 64 processors पर भी सिर्फ ~3.22 गुना तेज़.

q: Which of the following is scheme to deal with deadlock?
x: Time out तकनीक में process एक तय समय से ज़्यादा इंतज़ार नहीं करता, resource छोड़ कर फिर कोशिश करता है. इससे deadlock टूटता है.

q: A computer system supports 32 bit virtual address as well as 32 bit physical addresses. Since the virtual address space is of same size as that of physical address space, if we want to get rid of virtual memory, which one of the following is true?
o: Efficient implementation of multiuser support is no longer possible.
The processor cache can be made more efficient.
Hardware support for memory management is not needed.
CPU scheduling can be made more efficient.
x: Virtual memory हटा दें तो program सीधे physical address use करेगा. तब address बदलने वाले hardware (MMU (Memory Management Unit)) की ज़रूरत नहीं रहती.

q: If an instruction takes ‘i’ microseconds and a page fault takes an additional ‘j’ microseconds. The effective instruction time, if on the average a page fault occurs every k instructions, is
x: हर instruction का समय i है. k instructions में एक बार j का extra समय लगता है, तो औसतन हर instruction पर j/k extra.

q: ______ is sometimes said to be object oriented, because the only way to manipulate kernel objects is by invoking methods on their handles.
x: Silberschatz की किताब में Windows NT (New Technology) को object-oriented कहा गया है, क्योंकि kernel objects को सिर्फ उनके handle के methods से ही चलाया जाता है.

q: A user level process in Unix traps the signal sent on a Ctrl + C input and has a signal handling routine that saves appropriate files before terminating the process. When a Ctrl + C input is given to this process, what is the mode in which the signal handling routine executes?
x: Ctrl+C दबाने पर signal kernel भेजता है, इसलिए signal का काम kernel mode में शुरू होता है. Official key (B) kernel mode है. ध्यान रहे: handler का अपना code बाद में user mode में चलता है.

q: A thread is usually defined as a light weight process because an Operating System (OS) maintains smaller data structure for a thread than for a process. In relation to this, which of the following statement is correct ?
o: OS maintains only scheduling and accounting information for each thread.
OS maintains only CPU registers for each thread.
OS does not maintain a separate stack for each thread.
OS does not maintain virtual memory state for each thread.
x: NET key: (B). पर logic से (D) ज़्यादा सही है: threads एक ही process की memory share करते हैं, इसलिए OS हर thread की अलग virtual memory state नहीं रखता. GATE 2011 में यही सवाल था, वहाँ key (D) थी. Exam में NET key याद रखो, concept (D) वाला समझो.

q: What is the meaning of ‘Hibernate’ in Windows XP/Windows 7?
o: Restart the computers in safe mode.
Restart the computers in normal mode.
Shutdown the computer terminating all the running applications.
Shutdown the computer without closing the running applications.
x: Hibernate में खुले programs की स्थिति hard disk पर save होकर computer बंद होता है. दोबारा चालू करने पर सब वैसे ही खुलता है.

q: Which one of the following options is not a shell in UNIX system?
x: UNIX के प्रसिद्ध shells: Bourne (sh), C (csh), Korn (ksh), Bash. Net Shell इनमें नहीं है.

q:
On a disk with 1000 cylinders (0 to 999) find the number of tracks, the disk arm must move to satisfy all the requests in the disk queue. Assume the last request service was at track 345 and the head is moving toward track 0. The queue in FIFO order contains requests for the following tracks: 123, 874, 692, 475, 105, 376
(Assume SCAN algorithm)
x: SCAN (elevator) में head एक दिशा में आखिरी cylinder (यहाँ 0) तक जाता है, फिर पलट कर दूसरी दिशा की requests पूरी करता है.

q: An operating system using banker’s algorithm for deadlock avoidance has ten dedicated devices (of same type) and has three processes P1, P2 and P3 with maximum resource requirements of 4, 5 and 8 respectively. There are two states of allocation of devices as follows : State 1 Processes P1 P2 P3 Devices allocated 2 3 4 State 2 Processes P1 P2 P3 Devices allocated 0 2 4 Which of the following is correct ?
o: State 1 is unsafe and state 2 is safe.
State 1 is safe and state 2 is unsafe.
Both, state 1 and state 2 are safe.
Both, state 1 and state 2 are unsafe.
x: Banker's algorithm: state तभी safe है जब कोई ऐसा क्रम मिले जिसमें सारे processes पूरे हो सकें.

q: Let the time taken to switch between user mode and kernel mode of execution be T1 while time taken to switch between two user processes be T2. Which of the following is correct ?
o: Nothing can be said about the relation between T1 and T2.
x: User से kernel mode बदलना सिर्फ mode bit बदलना है. दो processes के बीच switch (context switch) में registers, memory map सब save/load होते हैं, इसलिए ज़्यादा समय लगता है.

q: Which of the following memory allocation scheme suffers from external fragmentation ?
x: External fragmentation = memory में कुल जगह है पर टुकड़ों में बिखरी है. Segmentation variable size है, इसलिए यह समस्या आती है.

q: In UNIX, which of the following command is used to set the task priority ?
x: UNIX में nice command से process की priority (nice value) तय की जाती है.

q: Working set model is used in memory management to implement the concept of
x: Program कुछ समय तक कुछ ही pages बार-बार use करता है (locality). Working set model इन्हीं pages को memory में रखता है.

q: The versions of windows operating system like windows XP and window Vista uses following file system :
x: Windows XP और Vista FAT-16, FAT-32 (File Allocation Table) और NTFS तीनों को support करते हैं. इसलिए 'All of the above'.

q: A UNIX file system has 1 KB block size and 4-byte disk addresses. What is the maximum file size if the inode contains ten direct block entries, one single indirect block entry, one double indirect block entry and one triple indirect block entry ?
x: inode में pointers होते हैं. एक block (1 KB) में 4-byte के 256 addresses आते हैं. Triple indirect सबसे बड़ा हिस्सा देता है.

q:
Match the following:
List – I List – II
a. Critical region 1. Hoares Monitor
b. Wait/signal 2. Mutual exclusion
c. Working set 3. Principal of locality
d. Dead lock 4. Circular wait
Codes:
 a b c d
x: Critical region = mutual exclusion; wait/signal = Hoare's monitor; working set = principle of locality; deadlock = circular wait.

q:
Which of the following features will characterize an OS as multi programmed OS?
(a) More than one program may be loaded into main memory at the same time.
(b) If a program waits for certain event another program is immediately scheduled.
(c) If the execution of a program terminates, another program is immediately scheduled.
x: Multiprogramming: कई programs memory में; एक रुका या खत्म हुआ तो तुरंत दूसरा चलता है, ताकि CPU खाली न बैठे.

q: A thread is a light weight process. In the above statement, weight refers to
x: Thread अपने process के code, data, files share करता है, अलग से कम resources चाहिए. इसलिए light weight.

q: Everything below the system call interface and above the physical hardware is known as ______.
x: Layers: User -> Shell/Programs -> System call interface -> Kernel -> Hardware. बीच का हिस्सा Kernel है.

q: Consider a system having m resources of the same type. These resources are shared by 3 processes A, B and C which have peak demands of 3, 4 and 6 respectively. For what value of m deadlock will not occur?
x: हर process को (peak − 1) दे दो, फिर 1 extra हो तो कोई एक पूरा होकर सब छोड़ देगा. इससे कम पर deadlock संभव.

q: Let f be the fraction of a computation (in terms of time) that is parallelizable, P the number of processors in the system, and sp the speed up achievable in comparison with sequential execution – then the sp can be calculated using the relation :
x: Amdahl's law: serial हिस्सा (1 − f) पूरा समय लेता है, parallel हिस्सा f, P processors में बँट कर f/P.

q:
A set of processors P1, P2….… Pk can execute in parallel if Bernstein’s conditions are satisfied on a pairwise basis; that is
P1 || P2 || P3 || ….. || Pk if and only if:
o: Pi || Pj for all i ≠ j
Pi || Pj for all i = j+1
Pi || Pj for all i < j
Pi || Pj for all i > j
x: Bernstein's conditions: सारे processes parallel तभी, जब हर अलग जोड़ी Pi, Pj (i ≠ j) parallel हो.

q: A virtual memory based memory management algorithm partially swaps out a process. This is an example of
x: Medium term scheduler memory हल्की करने के लिए process को (पूरा या आंशिक) disk पर भेजता है और बाद में वापस लाता है.

q: Let the page fault service time be 10 millisecond (ms) in a computer with average memory access time being 20 nanosecond (ns). If one page fault is generated for every 10^6 memory accesses, what is the effective access time for memory?
x: हर 10 लाख accesses में 1 बार page fault (10 ms). इसका औसत असर 10 ns बनता है.

q:
Consider the following UNIX command:
Sort <in> temp; head – 30 <temp; rm temp which of the following functions shall be performed by this command?
o: Sort, taking the input from “temp”, prints 30 lines from temp and delete the file temp
Sort the file “temp”, removes 30 lines from temp and delete the file temp
Sort, taking the input from “in” and writing the output to “temp” then prints 30 lines from temp on terminal. Finally “temp” is removed.
Sort, taking the input from “temp” and then prints 30 lines from “temp” on terminal. Finally “temp” is removed.
x: < = input file से, > = output file में. sort <in >temp, फिर head -30 temp की पहली 30 lines दिखाता है, rm temp हटा देता है.

q: The mv command changes
o: Both the directory entry and the inode
x: Same file system में mv सिर्फ नाम बदलता है, यानी directory entry. File का data और inode वही रहते हैं.

q: Consider the following processes with time slice of 4 milliseconds (I/O requests are ignored) : Process A B C D Arrival time 0 1 2 3 CPU cycle 8 4 9 5 The average turn around time of these processes will be
x: Round Robin, quantum 4 ms. TAT (Turn Around Time) = Completion − Arrival.

q: _____ is used to shift processes so they are contiguous, and all free memory is in one block.
o: More than one of the above
x: Memory में processes के बीच-बीच में छोटे खाली छेद (holes) रह जाते हैं. Compaction सारे processes को एक तरफ खिसकाकर खाली जगह को एक बड़े block में जोड़ देता है. (जैसे अलमारी में बिखरे कपड़ों को एक तरफ करके दूसरी तरफ खाली जगह बनाना.)

q: Which of the following is NOT a memory management technique used by operating systems?
o: More than one of the above
x: सवाल 'NOT' वाला है: जो technique नहीं है वह चुनना है. Paging और Segmentation memory बाँटने के तरीके हैं. Fragmentation उनसे पैदा होने वाली बर्बादी है.

q: Which of the following is a file system commonly used in operating systems?
o: More than one of the above
x: तीनों (NTFS, FAT32, HFS+) असली file systems हैं. जब एक से ज़्यादा option सही हों तो 'More than one of the above' चुनते हैं. BPSC में ऐसे सवाल बार-बार आते हैं.

q: What is a page in paging?
o: A fixed-size block of virtual memory
A fixed-size block of physical memory
More than one of the above
x: Paging में program की logical memory को बराबर टुकड़ों में काटते हैं: इन्हें page कहते हैं. RAM (Random Access Memory) को उसी size के टुकड़ों में काटते हैं: इन्हें frame कहते हैं. Page → Frame में रखा जाता है.

q: In a system with a page size of 4 KB and a physical address space of 64 GB, what is the number of bits required for the page offset?
o: More than one of the above
x: Page offset बताता है कि page के अंदर कौन-सा byte है. इसलिए offset bits = log2(page size).

q: What is a segment base in segmentation?
o: The starting address of a segment in physical memory
The starting address of a segment in virtual memory
The ending address of a segment in physical memory
More than one of the above
x: Segmentation में हर segment के लिए दो चीज़ें रखी जाती हैं: Base (RAM में शुरू कहाँ) और Limit (कितना लंबा). Physical address = Base + offset, बशर्ते offset < Limit.

q: What causes thrashing to occur?
o: More than one of the above
x: जब processes को ज़रूरी frames नहीं मिलते तो वे बार-बार page fault करते हैं. CPU (Central Processing Unit) का सारा समय pages अंदर-बाहर करने में जाता है और असली काम रुक जाता है. इसे thrashing कहते हैं.

q: Consider a system with a total physical memory of 8 GB and total virtual memory of 16 GB. If the system is using 6 GB of physical memory and 10 GB of virtual memory, how much memory is being swapped out?
o: More than one of the above
x: BPSC key: A (2 GB); logic से B (4 GB) (कारण: जितना virtual memory use हो रही है उसमें से जो physical में नहीं है वह swap area में है = 10 − 6 = 4 GB). Exam में BPSC की key (A) ही लिखो, पर concept याद रखो.

q: How is the TLB typically organized?
o: More than one of the above
x: TLB (Translation Lookaside Buffer) page→frame की जल्दी याद रखने वाली छोटी memory है. इसमें सारी entries एक साथ compare होती हैं, इसलिए इसे associative memory कहते हैं.

q: Which of the following is a common file operation?
o: More than one of the above
x: File के common operations: Create, Open, Read, Write, Close, Delete, Rename, Seek. तीनों option सही हैं, इसलिए D.

q: Consider a disk queue with requests for I/O to blocks on cylinders. 98 183 37 122 14 124 65 67 considering FCFS (First Come First Served) scheduling, the total number of head movements is, if the disk head is initially at 53 is?
o: More than one of the above
x: FCFS में disk head requests को आने के क्रम में ही पूरा करता है. हर कदम का फ़र्क जोड़ो.

q: Thread shares with other threads belonging to the same process its
o: More than one of the above
x: एक process के सारे threads code, data और open files share करते हैं. पर हर thread का अपना ID, program counter, registers और stack होता है.

q: Consider a program that consists of 8 pages (from 0 to 7) and we have 4 page frames in the physical memory for the pages. The page reference string is : 1 2 3 2 5 6 3 4 6 3 7 3 1 5 3 6 3 4 2 4 3 4 5 1 The number of page faults in LRU and optimal page replacement algorithms are respectively (without including initial page faults to fill available page frames with pages) :
x: LRU (Least Recently Used) = सबसे पुराना use हुआ page हटाओ. Optimal = जो आगे सबसे देर में use होगा उसे हटाओ.

q: In a paging system, it takes 30 ns to search translation Look-a-side Buffer (TLB) and 90 ns to access the main memory. If the TLB hit ratio is 70%, the effective memory access time is :
x: TLB hit पर TLB + memory. Miss पर TLB + page table + memory.

q: Consider the reference string 0 1 2 3 0 1 4 0 1 2 3 4 If FIFO page replacement algorithm is used, then the number of page faults with three page frames and four page frames are
x: FIFO में frames बढ़ाने पर faults कम होने चाहिए पर यहाँ बढ़ गए (9 → 10). इसे Belady's anomaly कहते हैं.

q: An operating system has 13 tape drives. There are three processes P1, P2 & P3. Maximum requirement of P1 is 11 tape drives, P2 is 5 tape drives and P3 is 8 tape drives. Currently, P1 is allocated 6 tape drives, P2 is allocated 3 tape drives and P3 is allocated 2 tape drives. Which of the following sequences represent a safe state ?
x: Safe state = ऐसा क्रम जिसमें हर process को उसकी maximum ज़रूरत मिल जाए. Banker's algorithm की सोच.

q: A scheduling Algorithm assigns priority proportional to the waiting time of a process. Every process starts with priority zero (lowest priority). The scheduler reevaluates the process priority for every ‘T’ time units and decides next process to be scheduled. If the process have no I/O operations and all arrive at time zero, then the scheduler implements
x: Priority = waiting time. हर T पर सबसे ज़्यादा wait वाला चलता है, फिर बाकी का wait बढ़ता है. इससे सब बारी-बारी चलते हैं = Round Robin.

q: Which of the following scheduling algorithms may cause starvation ? a. First-come-first-served b. Round Robin c. Priority d. Shortest process next e. Shortest remaining time first
x: जिस algorithm में छोटे या ऊँचे priority वालों को बार-बार आगे रखा जाए, वहाँ लंबे/कम priority वाले हमेशा इंतज़ार करते रह सकते हैं (starvation). इलाज = aging.

q: In which of the following scheduling criteria, context switching will never take place ?
x: Context switch = CPU को एक process से दूसरे को देना. Non-preemptive में process बीच में नहीं रुकता, इसलिए context switch नहीं होता.

q: Two atomic operations permissible on Semaphores are
x: Semaphore के दो atomic operations: wait() यानी P (घटाओ/रुको) और signal() यानी V (बढ़ाओ/जगाओ).

q:
Match the following:
List – I List - II
Process state transition Reason for transition
a Ready→ Running i. Request made by the process is satisfied or an event for which it was waiting occurs.
b Blocked→ Ready ii. Process wishes to wait for some action by another process.
c Running→ Blocked iii. The process is dispatched.
d Running→ Ready iv. The process is preempted.
Codes:
a b c d
x: Process के states: Ready (CPU का इंतज़ार), Running (CPU पर), Blocked (I/O का इंतज़ार). Ready→Running = dispatch; Running→Ready = preempt (time खत्म); Running→Blocked = process खुद wait करे; Blocked→Ready = इंतज़ार की चीज़ मिल गई.

q:
Consider the input/output (I/O) requests made at different instants of time directed at a hypothetical disk having 200 tracks as given in the following table:
Serial No. 1 2 3 4 5
Track No. 12 85 40 100 75
Time of arrival 65 80 110 100 175
Assume that :
Current head position is at track no. 65
Direction of last movement is towards higher numbered tracks
Current clock time is 160 milliseconds
Head movement time per track is 1 millisecond.
“look” is a variant of “SCAN” diskarm scheduling algorithm. In this algorithm, if no more I/O requests are left in current direction, the disk head reverses its direction. The seek times in Shortest Seek First (SSF) and “look” disk-arm scheduling algorithms respectively are :
x: Head 65 पर, clock 160 ms. तब तक requests 12, 85, 40, 100 आ चुकी हैं और 75 (175 ms पर) रास्ते में आ जाती है. 1 track = 1 ms.

q: _________ maintains the list of free disk blocks in the Unix file system.
x: UNIX file system में super block पूरे file system की जानकारी रखता है: size, free blocks और free inodes की list.

q: At a particular time of computation, the value of a counting semaphore is 10. Then 12 P operations and “x” V operations were performed on this semaphore. If the final value of semaphore is 7, x will be :
x: हर P (wait) value 1 घटाता है और हर V (signal) 1 बढ़ाता है.

q: Which of the following statements is not correct with reference to distributed systems?
o: Distributed system represents a global view of the network and considers it as a virtual uniprocessor system by controlling and managing resources across the network on all the sites.
Distributed system is built on bare machine, not an add-on to the existing software.

In a distributed system, kernel provides smallest possible set of services on which other services are built. This kernel is called microkernel. Open servers provide other services and access to shared resources.
In a distributed system, if a user wants to run the program on other nodes or share the resources on remote sites due to their beneficial aspects, user has to log on to that site.
x: Distributed OS में user को पता भी नहीं चलता कि program कहाँ चल रहा है (transparency). इसलिए 'दूसरी site पर log on करना पड़ता है' कथन गलत है. यह network OS की बात है.

q: One of the disadvantages of user level threads compared to Kernel level threads is
o: If a user level thread of a process executes a system call, all threads in that process are blocked.
Thread switching doesn’t require kernel mode privileges.
The library procedures invoked for thread management in user level threads are local procedures.
x: User-level thread को kernel जानता ही नहीं. इसलिए एक thread block हो तो kernel पूरे process को block कर देता है. यही बड़ा नुकसान है.

q:
Consider a disk system with 100 cylinders. The requests to access the cylinders occur in the following sequence:
4,34,10,7,19,73,2,15,6,20 
Assuming that the head is current at cylinder 50, what is the time taken to satisfy all requests if it takes 1ms to move from the cylinder to adjacent one and the shortest seek time first policy is used?
x: SSTF में हमेशा सबसे पास वाली request. 1 cylinder = 1 ms.

q:
Consider a main memory with 3 page frames for the following page reference string:
5, 4, 3, 2, 1, 4, 3, 5, 4, 3, 4, 1, 4
Assuming that the execution of process is initiated after loading page 5 in memory, the number of page faults in FIFO and second chance replacement respectively are
x: सवाल कहता है कि process page 5 load होने के बाद शुरू हुआ, यानी पहली बार 5 का fault नहीं गिनना.

q: The portion of Windows 2000 operating system which is not portable is
x: Windows 2000 का ज़्यादातर code portable है. जो हिस्सा processor के hardware से सीधे जुड़ा है, यानी virtual memory management, portable नहीं माना गया (NET key).

q:
Match the following for Windows Operating System:
(a) Hardware abstraction layer (i) Starting all processes, emulation of different operating systems, security functions, transform character based applications to graphical representation.
(b) Kernel (ii) Export a virtual memory interface, support for symmetric multiprocessing administration, details of mapping memory, configuring I/O buses, setting up DMA.
(c) Executive (iii) Thread scheduling, interrupt and exception handling, recovery after power failure.
(d) Win32 subsystem (iv) Object manager, virtual memory manager, process manager, plug and- play and power manager.
Codes:
(a) (b) (c) (d)
x: HAL (ii): hardware के details छुपाता है, I/O buses, DMA (Direct Memory Access). Kernel (iii): thread scheduling, interrupts, power-failure recovery. Executive (iv): object, virtual memory और process manager. Win32 subsystem (i): applications चलाना.

q: Which of the following statements is not true for UNIX Operating System?
o: Major strength of UNIX Operating System is its open standards which enabled large number of organizations ranging from academician to industries to participate in its development.
UNIX kernel uses modules with well specified interfaces and provides advantages like simplified testing and maintenance of kernel. It has better extensibility as the kernel is not monolithic.
UNIX is kernel based operating system with two main components viz. process management subsystem and file management subsystem.
All devices are represented as files which simplify the management of I/O devices and files. The directories structure used is directed acyclic graph.
x: UNIX का kernel monolithic (एक बड़ा पूरा block) माना जाता है. इसलिए 'kernel monolithic नहीं है' कहने वाला कथन गलत है.

q: The virtual address generated by a CPU is 32 bits. The Translation Look-aside Buffer (TLB) can hold total 64 page table entries and a 4-way set associative (i.e. with 4- cache lines in the set). The page size is 4 KB. The minimum size of TLB tag is
x: TLB में page number (VPN, Virtual Page Number) का एक हिस्सा set चुनता है (index) और बाकी हिस्सा tag बनता है.

q: Linux operating system uses
x: Linux का scheduler सब processes को बराबर CPU समय देने की कोशिश करता है और ज़रूरत पर process को बीच में रोक देता है (preemptive).

q:
Consider a disk queue with request for input/output to block on cylinders
98, 183, 37, 122, 14, 124, 65, 67
in that order. Assume that disk head is initially positioned at cylinder 53 and moving towards cylinder number 0. The total number of head movements using Shortest Seek Time First (SSTF) and SCAN algorithms are respectively
x: Head 53 पर, 0 की तरफ जा रहा है. SSTF हमेशा सबसे पास वाली request लेता है.

q: In Unix, how do you check that two given strings a and b are equal ?
x: UNIX shell में strings की बराबरी = (single equals) से जाँचते हैं, numbers की -eq से.

q: In windows 2000 operating system all the processor-dependent code is isolated in a dynamic link library called
x: Windows 2000 में hardware के फ़र्क को HAL (एक DLL, Dynamic Link Library) छुपाता है ताकि बाकी OS बदलना न पड़े.

q: Translation Look-aside Buffer (TLB) is
o: a cache-memory in which item to be searched is compared one-by-one with the keys.
a cache-memory in which item to be searched is compared with all the keys simultaneously.
an associative memory in which item to be searched is compared one-by-one with the keys.
an associative memory in which item to be searched is compared with all the keys simultaneously.
x: TLB associative memory है: दी गई key सभी entries से एक साथ मिलाई जाती है, इसलिए यह तेज़ है.

q: Simplest way of deadlock recovery is
x: Deadlock हटाने के तरीके: process kill करना (सबसे आसान), resource preempt करना, roll back करना. Kill करने में बस process हटाओ और resources free हो जाते हैं.

q: The directory structure used in Unix file system is called
x: UNIX में एक file के कई नाम (links) हो सकते हैं, पर cycle नहीं बनने देते. इसलिए structure DAG है.

q: Which statement is not true about process O in the Unix operating system ?
o: Process O is called init process.
Process O is not created by fork system call.
After forking process 1, process O becomes swapper process.
Process O is a special process created when system boots.
x: UNIX में process 0 boot के समय बनता है (fork से नहीं). वह process 1 (init) बनाकर swapper बन जाता है. 'Process 0 = init' कहना गलत है.

q: In UNIX, processes that have finished execution but have not yet had their status collected are known as
x: Child process खत्म हो गया पर parent ने wait() से उसका status नहीं लिया: वह zombie है (process table में अटका). Parent पहले मर जाए तो child orphan बनता है.

q: Possible thread states in Windows 2000 operating system include :
o: Ready, standby, running, waiting, transition and terminated
Ready, running, waiting, transition and terminated
x: Windows 2000 में thread की 6 states होती हैं: Ready, Standby, Running, Waiting, Transition, Terminated.

q: In a paged memory management algorithm, the hit ratio is 70%. If it takes 30 nanoseconds to search Translation Look-aside Buffer (TLB) and 100 nanoseconds (ns) to access memory, the effective memory access time is
x: Hit पर TLB search + memory access. Miss पर TLB search + page table access + memory access.

q: Match the following : List – I List – II a. Multilevel feedback queue i. Time-slicing b. FCFS ii. Criteria to move processes between queues c. Shortest process next iii. Batch processing d. Round robin scheduling iv. Exponential smoothening Codes : a b c d
x: MLFQ में process queues के बीच खिसकता है (criteria to move). FCFS batch में चलता है. SPN (Shortest Process Next) में अगला burst अंदाज़े से (exponential smoothing) लगाते हैं. RR (Round Robin) में time-slicing होती है.

q: Which of the following commands will output “onetwothree” ?
o: for val; do echo-n $val; done < one two three
for one two three; do echo-n-; done
for n in one two three; do echo-n $n; done
for n in one two three {echo –n $ n}
x: Shell loop का syntax: for var in list; do command; done. echo -n newline नहीं छापता, इसलिए output onetwothree एक लाइन में आता है.

q: Which of the following is the correct value returned to the operating system upon the successful completion of a program ?
o: Program do not return a value.
x: UNIX/C++ में main() सफल होने पर 0 लौटाता है. कोई भी non-zero error माना जाता है.

q: Match the following : List – I List – II a. Timeout ordering protocol i. Wait for graph b. Deadlock prevention ii. Roll back c. Deadlock detection iii. Wait-die scheme d. Deadlock recovery iv. Thomas Write Rule Codes : a b c d
x: Wait-die deadlock prevention की scheme है. Wait-for graph से deadlock detect होता है. Roll back recovery है. Thomas write rule timestamp ordering protocol में आता है.

इस तरह के सवाल में P1 तब अंदर जाता है जब S1 और S2 बराबर न हों और P2 तब जाता है जब बराबर हों (असली पेपर में P2 की line 'while (S1 != S2)' थी)। दोनों की शर्त उल्टी है, इसलिए एक ही समय पर दोनों अंदर नहीं जा सकते = Mutual Exclusion (एक समय में एक ही process) पक्का। पर अगर P1 को बार-बार अंदर जाना हो तो उसे P2 की बारी का इंतज़ार करना पड़ता है = Progress नहीं। BPSC/NET key: A।

q: Which of the following concurrency protocol ensures both conflict serializability and freedom from deadlock : I. 2-phase locking II. Time phase ordering
x: 2PL (Two-Phase Locking) में lock के लिए इंतज़ार होता है, इसलिए deadlock (दो transactions का एक-दूसरे का इंतज़ार) हो सकता है। Timestamp Ordering में कोई इंतज़ार नहीं होता, transaction सीधे abort/restart होती है, इसलिए deadlock नहीं होता और conflict serializable रहता है। सही: सिर्फ II।

q: Consider a uniprocessor system where new processes arrive at an average of five processes per minute and each process needs an average of 6 seconds of service time. What will be the CPU utilization ?
x: CPU Utilization (CPU कितने % busy रहा) = arrival rate × service time। यहाँ 5 process/मिनट × 6 सेकंड = 30 सेकंड काम हर 60 सेकंड में = 50%।

q: Which of the following statements is not true about disk-arm scheduling algorithms ?
o: SSTF (shortest seek time first) algorithm increases performance of FCFS.
The number of requests for disk service are not influenced by file allocation method.
Caching the directories and index blocks in main memory can also help in reducing disk arm movements.
SCAN and C-SCAN algorithms are less likely to have a starvation problem.
x: SSTF (Shortest Seek Time First) FCFS से बेहतर चलता है, पर starvation दे सकता है। SCAN/C-SCAN में starvation कम होता है। पर 'file allocation method disk requests की संख्या पर असर नहीं डालता' गलत है, क्योंकि contiguous/linked/indexed का तरीका ही तय करता है कि कितने disk access लगेंगे। इसलिए 'not true' वाला option B है।

q: A part of Windows 2000 operating system that is not portable is
x: Windows 2000 का जो हिस्सा hardware पर निर्भर है वह portable नहीं होता। UGC NET key के अनुसार Virtual Memory Management (page table की बनावट processor पर निर्भर) portable नहीं है। यह एक याद करने वाला fact है।

q: Match the following with reference to Unix shell scripts : List – I List – II a. $? i. File name of the current script b. $# ii. List of arguments c. $0 iii. The number of arguments d. $* iv. Exit status of last command Codes : a b c d
x: UNIX shell script के special variables: $? = पिछले command का exit status (0 मतलब सफल), $# = arguments की गिनती, $0 = script का नाम, $* = सारे arguments की list।

q: The output generated by the LINUX command : $ seq 1 2 10 will be
x: `seq FIRST INCREMENT LAST` — यहाँ 1 से शुरू, 2 के step से, 10 तक: 1 3 5 7 9। बीच का नंबर step होता है, end नहीं।

q: Consider the following justifications for commonly using the two-level CPU scheduling : I. It is used when memory is too small to hold all the ready processes. II. Because its performance is same as that of the FIFO. III. Because it facilitates putting some set of processes into memory and a choice is made from that. IV. Because it does not allow to adjust the set of in-core processes. Which of the following is true ?
x: Two-level scheduling तब काम आता है जब memory सारे ready processes के लिए छोटी हो: कुछ processes memory में रखे जाते हैं और उन्हीं में से चुनाव होता है (I और III)। इसका performance FIFO जैसा नहीं होता, और यह in-core set को adjust करने देता है (IV गलत)।

q: Which of the following conditions does not hold good for a solution to a critical section problem ?
o: No assumptions may be made about speeds or the number of CPUs.
No two processes may be simultaneously inside their critical sections.
Processes running outside its critical section may block other processes.
Processes do not wait forever to enter its critical section.
x: Critical Section (ऐसा code हिस्सा जहाँ shared data छुआ जाता है) की शर्तें: Mutual Exclusion (एक समय में एक), Progress (बाहर वाला दूसरे को न रोके), Bounded Waiting (कोई हमेशा इंतज़ार न करे), और speed/CPU संख्या की कोई मान्यता नहीं। 'बाहर वाले process रोक सकते हैं' शर्त नहीं बल्कि उसके उल्टी बात है।

q: In a demand paging memory system, page table is held in registers. The time taken to service a page fault is 8 m.sec. if an empty frame is available or if the replaced page is not modified, and it takes 20 m.secs., if the replaced page is modified. What is the average access time to service a page fault assuming that the page to be replaced is modified 70% of the time ?
x: Page fault का average service time = (modified होने की probability × 20 ms) + (not modified की × 8 ms)। यहाँ 70% modified: 0.7×20 + 0.3×8 = 16.4 ms।

q: Which methods are utilized to control the access to an object in multi-threaded programming ?
x: Multi-threaded programming (Java) में एक object को एक समय में एक ही thread चलाए, इसके लिए synchronized methods/blocks का उपयोग होता है। इसमें lock (monitor) लगता है।

q: Consider an imaginary disk with 40 cylinders. A request come to read a block on cylinder 11. While the seek to cylinder 11 is in progress, new requests come in for cylinders 1, 36, 16, 34, 9 and 12 in that order. The number of arm motions using shortest seek first algorithm is
x: SSTF (Shortest Seek Time First): हेड हमेशा अभी की position से सबसे पास वाली request लेता है। शुरुआत 11 से। कुल arm motion = सारे steps का योग = 61।

q: Monitor is an Interprocess Communication (IPC) technique which can be described as
o: It is higher level synchronization primitive and is a collection of procedures, variables, and data structures grouped together in a special package.
It is a non-negative integer which apart from initialization can be acted upon by wait and signal operations.
It uses two primitives, send and receive which are system calls rather than language constructs.
It consists of the IPC primitives implemented as system calls to block the process when they are not allowed to enter critical region to save CPU time.
x: Monitor एक high-level synchronization tool है: procedures, variables और data structures एक package में, और एक समय में एक ही process monitor के अंदर रह सकता है। Semaphore = non-negative integer (wait/signal), Message passing = send/receive।

q: Which of the following versions of Windows O.S. contain built-in partition manager which allows us to shrink and expand pre-defined drives ?
x: Windows Vista में पहली बार built-in disk partition manager (Disk Management में Shrink/Extend Volume) आया। 98, 2000, NT में यह सुविधा नहीं थी।

q: In Unix operating system, when a process creates a new process using the fork () system call, which of the following state is shared between the parent process and child process ?
x: fork() से child बनने पर child को parent के stack और heap की अलग कॉपी मिलती है। पर shared memory segments parent-child दोनों के बीच साझा रहते हैं।

q: Which of the following information about the UNIX file system is not correct ?
o: Super block contains the number of i-nodes, the number of disk blocks, and the start of the list of free disk blocks.
An i-node contains accounting information as well as enough information to locate all the disk blocks that holds the file’s data.
All the files and directories are stored in data blocks.
x: UNIX file system: Super block में i-nodes की संख्या, blocks की संख्या और free blocks की list शुरू होती है। i-node में file का हिसाब और data blocks का पता होता है। पर i-node की size 256 bytes नहीं, परंपरागत रूप से 64 bytes होती है। Files और directories data blocks में रहते हैं।

q: Which of the following option with reference to UNIX operating system is not correct ?
o: INT signal is sent by the terminal driver when one types <Control-C> and it is a request to terminate the current operation.
TERM is a request to terminate execution completely. The receiving process will clean up its state and exit.
QUIT is similar to TERM, except that it defaults to producing a core dump if not caught.
x: UNIX signals: INT (Ctrl-C) रोकने की request; TERM साफ-सफाई करके रुकने की request; QUIT = TERM + core dump; KILL को block या catch नहीं किया जा सकता (यह पक्का मारता है)। इसलिए 'KILL blockable है' गलत है।

q: What is the function of following UNIX command ? WC – l <a > b &
o: It runs the word count program to count the number of lines in its input, a, writing the result to b, as a foreground process.
It runs the word count program to count the number of lines in its input, a, writing the result to b, but does it in the background.
It counts the errors during the execution of a process, a, and puts the result in process b.
It copies the ‘l’ numbers of lines of program from file, a, and stores in file b.
x: `wc -l <a >b &` : wc = word count, -l = lines गिनो, <a = a से input लो, >b = result b में लिखो, & = background में चलाओ।

q: Which of the following statement is not correct with reference to cron daemon in UNIX O.S. ?
o: The cron daemon is the standard tool for running commands on a pre-determined schedule.
It starts when the system boots and runs as long as the system is up.
Cron reads configuration files that contain list of command lines and the times at which they invoked.
Crontab for individual users are not stored.
x: cron daemon (हमेशा चलने वाला service) निर्धारित समय पर commands चलाता है; boot पर शुरू होता है; config files पढ़ता है। हर user की crontab file स्टोर की जाती है, इसलिए 'crontab stored नहीं होती' गलत है।

q: Suppose a system has 12 instances of some resources with n processes competing for that resource. Each process may require 4 instances of the resource. The maximum value of n for which the system never enters into deadlock is
x: Deadlock से बचने का नियम: n processes, हर को अधिकतम m resources चाहिए, कुल R resources। deadlock नहीं होगा अगर R ≥ n×(m−1) + 1। यहाँ 12 ≥ n×3 + 1 → n ≤ 3.67 → अधिकतम n = 3।

q: A computer has six tapes drives with n processes competing for them. Each process may need two drives. What is the maximum value of n for the system to be deadlock free?
x: वही नियम: R ≥ n×(m−1)+1। यहाँ R=6 tape drives, m=2। 6 ≥ n×1 + 1 → n ≤ 5। अधिकतम n = 5।

q: Suppose P,Q and R are co-operating processes satisfying Mutual Exclusion condition. Then if the process Q is executing in its critical section then
o: Neither ‘P’ nor ‘Q’ executes in their critical section
Both ‘P’ and ‘R’ executes in critical section
x: Mutual Exclusion का मतलब: जब Q अपने critical section में है, तब P और R में से कोई भी अपने critical section में नहीं हो सकता।

q: At particular time of computation, the value of a counting semaphore is 7.Then 20p operations and 'x' V operations were completed on this semaphore.if the final value of semaphore is 5,x will be
x: Counting semaphore (गिनती वाला signal): P (wait) operation मान 1 घटाता है, V (signal) 1 बढ़ाता है। शुरू 7, 20 P → 7−20, x V → +x, अंत 5: 7 − 20 + x = 5 → x = 18।

q: If an operating system does not allow a child process to exist when the parent process has been terminated, this phenomenon is calls as-
x: अगर parent के खत्म होने पर OS child को भी खत्म कर देता है तो इसे Cascading Termination कहते हैं। UNIX में child अनाथ (orphan) रहकर चलता है, पर कुछ OS ऐसा नहीं होने देते।

q: In Linux operating system, when ______ is invoked, it is passed a set of flags that determine how much sharing is to take place between the parent and child tasks.
x: Linux में clone() system call से thread या process बनता है। इसके साथ flags दिए जाते हैं जो तय करते हैं कि parent-child के बीच कितना कुछ share होगा (memory, files, signals)। fork() में flags नहीं होते।

q: The main function of the microkernel is to provide a communication facility between the _____ program and the various ______ that are also running in user space.
x: Microkernel (छोटा kernel) का मुख्य काम client program और उन services के बीच communication करना है जो user space में चलती हैं (जैसे file server)। Message passing इसके लिए है।

q:
Which of the following concurrency control protocols ensure both conflict serializability and freedom from deadlock?
Statement I: Two phase locking
Statement II: Timestamp ordering
In the light of the above statements, choose the most appropriate answer from the options given below:
o: Both statement I and statement II are correct
Both statement I and statement II are incorrect
Statement I is correct but Statement Ii is incorrect
Statement I is incorrect but Statement Ii is correct
x: Statement I (2PL) गलत है क्योंकि 2PL में deadlock हो सकता है। Statement II (Timestamp ordering) सही है, क्योंकि इसमें कोई लॉक-इंतज़ार नहीं होता और यह conflict serializable व deadlock-free है। इसलिए I गलत, II सही।

q:
Match List I with List II: 
List I List II 
(A) Stack Algorithm (I) Deadloack 
(B) Elevator algorithm (II) Disk Scheduling 
(C) Priority scheduling algorithm (III) Page replacement 
(D) Havender algorithm (IV) CPU Scheduling 
CHoose the correct answer from the options given below:
x: Match: Stack Algorithm = Page replacement (LRU, Optimal जैसे); Elevator algorithm = Disk scheduling (SCAN); Priority = CPU Scheduling; Havender algorithm = Deadlock (prevention की पद्धति)।

q: Consider a single-level page table system, with the page table stored in the memory. If the hit rate to TLB is 80%, and it takes 15 nanoseconds to search the TLB, and 150 nanoseconds to access the main memory, then what is the effective memory access time, in nanoseconds?
x: Single-level page table memory में है: TLB hit पर सिर्फ 1 memory access; miss पर page table के लिए 1 और data के लिए 1। EAT (Effective Access Time) = h×(T+M) + (1−h)×(T+M+M)।

q: What is the total swap time (Swap in & Swap out) in a system for a 15 MB process with a transfer rate of 30 MBps, given an average latency of 12 ms (no head seeks involved)?
x: Swap time = (process size ÷ transfer rate) एक बार बाहर, एक बार अंदर + हर बार latency। 15 MB ÷ 30 MBps = 0.5 s। Swap out + swap in = 1.0 s। Latency 12 ms × 2 = 24 ms। Total = 1.024 s।

q: Consider a virtual page reference string 1, 2, 3, 2, 4, 2, 5, 2, 3, 4. Suppose LRU page replacement algorithm is implemented with 3 page frames in main memory. Then the number of page faults are
x: LRU (Least Recently Used) = सबसे पुराना use हुआ page हटाओ। 3 frames के साथ reference string 1,2,3,2,4,2,5,2,3,4 में 7 page faults आते हैं।

q: Page information in memory is also called as Page Table. The essential contents in each entry of a page table is/are
o: Both virtual page number and Page Frame Number
x: Page table की हर entry में ज़रूरी चीज़ Page Frame number है (यानी वह page RAM के किस frame में है)। Virtual page number तो entry का index (क्रम) होता है, अलग से store नहीं होता।

q: Which UNIX/Linux command is used to make all files and sub-directories in the directory “progs” executable by all users ?
x: `chmod` = permission बदलो, `-R` = recursive (सब sub-folders भी), `a+x` = सबके लिए execute जोड़ो। इसलिए `chmod -R a+x progs`।

q: Which of the following statements is correct for Pthreads?
o: This standard defines API for thread creation only
This is a specification only for thread behavior and not its implementation
Operating systems like Solaris, Linux, and Mac OS X (except Tru64 UNIX) implement Pthreads
x: Pthreads POSIX thread का standard है; यह thread के behavior की specification है, implementation नहीं (Solaris, Linux, Mac OS X इसे लागू करते हैं)। यह सिर्फ creation का API नहीं, synchronization भी देता है। key: C।

q: Suppose you have a Linux file system where the block size is 2K bytes, a disk address is 32 bits, and i-node contains the disk addresses of the first 12 direct blocks of file, a single indirect block, and a double indirect block. Approximately, what is the largest file that can be represented by an i-node?
x: i-node में 12 direct blocks, 1 single indirect और 1 double indirect pointer हैं। block = 2 KB, address 32 bit = 4 bytes → एक block में 2048/4 = 512 pointers। Direct = 12×2 KB = 24 KB; single = 512×2 KB = 1 MB; double = 512×512×2 KB = 512 MB। कुल ≈ 513 MB।

q: If a process is under statistical control, then it is
x: Process 'statistical control' में हो यानी उसका behaviour stable है। Stable process का अगला नतीजा अंदाज़े से बताया जा सकता है, इसलिए वह Predictable (अनुमान-योग्य) है। (यह Software Engineering का सवाल है, OS का नहीं।)

q: If a packet arrive with an M-bit value is ‘l’ and a fragmentation offset value ‘0’, then it is ______ fragment.
x: IP (Internet Protocol) fragmentation में MF (More Fragments) bit 1 का मतलब आगे और fragments हैं। Offset 0 का मतलब यह शुरुआत है। इसलिए यह First fragment है। (Networks का सवाल।)

q: The maturity levels used to measure a process are
x: CMM (Capability Maturity Model) के 5 levels: Initial, Repeatable, Defined, Managed, Optimizing। यही क्रम option A में है। (Software Engineering का सवाल।)

q: If a packet arrives with an M-bit value is ‘l’ and a fragmentation offset value ‘0’, and then it is ______ fragment.
x: यह वही सवाल है: MF=1 और offset=0 मतलब First fragment। Bank key 'All of the above' दी है, पर logic से सिर्फ First सही है। BPSC/NET में ऐसा सवाल आए तो First चुनो।

q: Given memory partitions of 100 K, 500 K, 200 K, 300 K and 600 K (in order) and processes of 212 K, 417 K, 112 K, and 426 K (in order), using the first-fit algorithm, in which partition would the process requiring 426 K be placed?
x: Silberschatz के इसी सवाल का standard तर्क: first-fit में 212→500, 417→600, 112→बची 288 वाले 500 में, फिर 426 K के लिए कोई partition नहीं बचता। 426 K को सिर्फ best-fit में 600 K मिलता है (212→300, 417→500, 112→200, 426→600)। सवाल की wording में गड़बड़ी है; सबसे सही मेल 600 K है। Bank key 200 K थी, जो किसी भी तरीके से 426 के लिए बहुत छोटा है।

q: If a packet arrive with an M-bit value is ‘1’ and a fragmentation offset value ‘0’, then it is ______ fragment.
x: फिर वही सवाल: MF=1 + offset 0 = First fragment।

q:
If we convert ∃u ∀v ∀x ∃y (P(f(u),v, x, y) → Q(u,v,y)) to ∀v ∀x (P(f(a),v, x, g(v,x)) → Q(a,v,g(v,x)))
This process is known as
x: First-order logic में ∃ (there exists) वाले variable को constant (a) या function (g(v,x)) से बदलना *Skolemization* कहलाता है। यहाँ ∃u की जगह a और ∃y की जगह g(v,x) आया है। (AI का सवाल।)

q: Which of the following set of UNIX commands will always display “WELCOME”?
x: Bank key B है। Shell में double quote "echo $title" का $title बाहर वाला shell पहले ही expand कर देता है, इसलिए मान WELCOME ही दिखता है। (Options में 'Title = WELCOME' असल shell में spaces की वजह से error देता; यह scrape हुए options की गड़बड़ी हो सकती है।) Exam में bank key B ही याद रखो।

q:
Match the following:
(a) Dangling pointer (i) Buffer replacement policy
(b) Page fault (ii) Variable length records
(c) List representation (iii) Object identifier
(d) Toss immediate (iv) Pointer-swizzling
Codes:
 (a) (b) (c) (d)
x: Match: Dangling pointer → Object identifier (OID से dangling की जाँच), Page fault → Pointer-swizzling (page memory में आने पर pointer बदलना), List representation → Variable length records, Toss immediate → Buffer replacement policy। यह Database का सवाल है।

q: A system has 10 units of one resource type. Process P has maximum need 7 and holds 3; Q has maximum need 4 and holds 2; R has maximum need 5 and holds 3. Request (i): P asks for 2 more units. Request (ii): Q asks for 2 more units. Which request, if granted, keeps the system in a safe state?
x: अभी free = 10 − (3+2+3) = 2। Q को 2 दे दें तो Q का काम पूरा हो सकता है और वह 4 units लौटाएगा; फिर P और R भी पूरे हो जाते हैं (safe)। P को 2 दें तो free 0 रह जाता है और कोई process आगे नहीं बढ़ पाता (unsafe)।

q: Processes A, B, C arrive at time 0 with CPU burst times 3 ms, 1 ms and 2 ms respectively (ready queue order A-B-C). Using Round Robin scheduling with time quantum 1 ms, the average turnaround time is
x: Round Robin (RR) में हर process को बारी-बारी 1 ms मिलता है। क्रम A, B, C, A, C, A। B 2 पर, C 5 पर, A 6 पर पूरा। Turnaround = पूरा होने का समय − arrival (0)। औसत = (6+2+5)/3 = 13/3।

q: Which of the following commands would return process_id of sleep command ?
x: Background में चलाए गए command (sleep 1 &) का PID (Process IDentifier) `$!` में रहता है। `$?` = पिछले command का exit status, `$#` = arguments की संख्या। Bank key 0 दी है पर logic से `$!` ही सही है, और option D यही है।

q: Requirement Development, Organizational Process Focus, Organizational Training, Risk Management and Integrated Supplier Management are process areas required to achieve maturity level
x: CMMI (Capability Maturity Model Integration) में Level 3 = Defined। इसमें Requirement Development, Organizational Process Focus, Training, Risk Management, Integrated Supplier Management आते हैं। (Software Engineering।)

q: Consider the following statements : I. Re-construction operation used in mixed fragmentation satisfies commutative rule. II. Re-construction operation used in vertical fragmentation satisfies commutative rule Which of the following is correct ?
o: None of the statements are correct.
x: Bank key: 'None of the statements are correct'। यह Database (fragmentation) का सवाल है, OS का नहीं। Horizontal के लिए UNION और vertical के लिए JOIN से reconstruct होता है; key के अनुसार दोनों statements गलत मानी गई हैं। Key याद रखो।

q: A computer based information system is needed : I. as it is difficult for administrative staff to process data. II. due to rapid growth of information and communication technology. III. due to growing size of organizations which need to process large volume of data. IV. as timely and accurate decisions are to be taken. Which of the above statement(s) is/are true ?
x: Computer-based Information System की ज़रूरत: संस्थाओं का आकार बढ़ा, इसलिए data बहुत है (III), और समय पर सही फ़ैसले चाहिए (IV)। I गलत है (प्रशासन data process कर सकता है, बस धीमा), II को key मुख्य कारण नहीं मानती। (MIS का सवाल।)

q: Which of the following is not a basic primitive of the Graphics Kernel System (GKS)?
x: GKS (Graphics Kernel System) के primitives: POLYLINE, POLYMARKER, TEXT, FILL AREA, CELL ARRAY, GDP (Generalized Drawing Primitive)। POLYDRAW इनमें नहीं है। (Graphics का सवाल।)

q: In Unix, files can be protected by assigning each one a 9-bit mode called rights bits. Now, consider the following two statements: I. A mode of 641 (octal) means that the owner can read and write the file, other members of the owner’s group can read it, and users can execute only. II. A mode of 100 (octal) allows the owner to execute the file, but prohibits all other access. Which of the following options is correct with reference to above statements ?
o: Both I and II are correct.
Both I and II are incorrect.
x: UNIX में 9-bit mode = owner/group/others × rwx। r=4, w=2, x=1। 641 = 6 (rw-) owner, 4 (r--) group, 1 (--x) others: statement I सही। 100 = owner सिर्फ execute: statement II सही।

q: Match the following for Unix file system : List – I List – II a. Boot block i. Information about file system, free block list, free inode list etc. b. Super block ii. Contains operating system files as well as program and data files created by users. c. Inode block iii. Contains boot program and partition table. d. Data block iv. Contains a table for every file in the file system. Attributes of files are stored here. Codes : a b c d
x: UNIX file system के 4 हिस्से: Boot block (boot program, partition table), Super block (file system की जानकारी, free block/inode list), Inode block (हर file की table और attributes), Data block (user files और OS files)।

q: Which statement is not correct about “init” process in Unix ?
o: It is generally the parent of the login shell.
It is the first process in the system.
Init forks and execs a ‘getty’ process at every port connected to a terminal.
x: init UNIX में पहला *user-level* process है, PID 1 होता है, login shell का parent है और getty को ports पर चलाता है। 'It is the first process in the system' को key गलत मानती है क्योंकि kernel के कुछ processes (जैसे swapper, PID 0) उससे पहले होते हैं।

q: Unix command to change the case of first three lines of file “shortlist” from lower to upper
x: पहले head -3 shortlist से पहली 3 lines निकालो, फिर pipe (|) से tr को दो, जो lower को upper बनाता है। tr खुद file नहीं पढ़ता, वह सिर्फ standard input से पढ़ता है।

q: Match the following vi commands in Unix : List – I List – II a. : w i. saves the file and quits editing mode b. : x ii. escapes unix shell c. : q iii. saves file and remains in editing mode d. : sh iv. quits editing mode and no changes are saved to the file Codes : a b c d
x: vi editor: :w = save करो और editing जारी रखो, :x = save + quit, :q = बिना save quit (सिर्फ अगर बदलाव न हों), :sh = UNIX shell में जाना। Match: a-iii, b-i, c-iv, d-ii।

q: Which of the following is incorrect for virtual memory?
o: Faster and easy swapping of process
x: Virtual memory से बड़े programs चल सकते हैं (A सही), swapping आसान होती है (D सही), पर page faults की वजह से I/O (Input/Output) ज़्यादा लगता है। Bank key C है (key याद रखो); असल में 'ज़्यादा I/O' भी virtual memory का नुकसान ही है।

q: Which speed up could be achieved according to Amdahl’s Law for infinite number of processes if 5% of a program is sequential and the remaining part is ideally parallel ?
x: Amdahl's Law: Speedup = 1 / (S + (1−S)/N)। N = अनंत, S = 0.05 पर speedup = 1/0.05 = 20। यानी sequential हिस्सा ही अधिकतम limit तय करता है।

q: Which of the following statements are true ? (a) External Fragmentation exists when there is enough total memory space to satisfy a request but the available space is contiguous. (b) Memory Fragmentation can be internal as well as external. (c) One solution to external Fragmentation is compaction. Code :
x: External fragmentation वह है जब कुल खाली memory काफ़ी है पर वह *contiguous नहीं* (टुकड़ों में बँटी) है। (a) में 'contiguous है' लिखा है, इसलिए (a) गलत। (b) सही: fragmentation internal भी होता है और external भी। (c) सही: compaction (टुकड़े समेटना) इसका हल है।

q: Database systems that store each relation in a separate operating system file may use the operating system’s authorization scheme, instead of defining a special scheme themselves. In this case, which of the following is false ?
o: The administrator enjoys more control on the grant option.
It is difficult to differentiate among the update, delete and insert authorizations.
Cannot store more than one relation in a file.
Operations on the database are speeded up as the authorization procedure is carried out at the operating system level.
x: जब database OS की file authorization इस्तेमाल करे: हर relation अलग file में रहती है, इसलिए update/delete/insert में फ़र्क करना कठिन है (B सही), एक file में एक ही relation (C सही), OS-level check से तेज़ी (D सही)। 'Administrator को grant option पर ज़्यादा control' गलत है, क्योंकि OS की scheme में control कम होता है।

q:
Which of the following cloud concept/s is/are related to pooling and sharing of resources?
A) Virtual Memory
B) Service
C) Virtualization
Choose the correct answer from the options given below:
x: Cloud में resources को pool और share करने की तकनीक *Virtualization* है (एक physical मशीन पर कई virtual मशीनें)। Virtual Memory CPU/OS की memory trick है, और Service एक अलग concept है।

q:
Match List I with List II: 
List I List II 
(A) Least frequently used (I) Memory is distributed among processors 
(B) Critical Section (II) Page replacement policy in cache memory 
(C) Loosely coupled multiprocessor system (III) Program section that once begin must complete execution before another processor access the same shared resource 
(D) Distributed operating system organization (IV) O/S routines are distributed among available processors. 
Choose the correct answer from the options given below:
